<function name="IsAreaTraversable" parent="CLuaLocomotion" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this <page>CLuaLocomotion</page> can reach and/or traverse/move in given <page>CNavArea</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="area" type="CNavArea">The area to test</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether this <page>CLuaLocomotion</page> can traverse given <page>CNavArea</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
